base.description: Moser lattice ℤ⟨1,ζ₆,ω₃,ζ₆ω₃⟩ ball, exact radius cut, radius 41/20

claim_scope: EXACT: the sign of every radicand D = ab − k² is decided by `ksign`, not by a float; unordered radius pairs are canonicalised by exact comparison. NOTHING IS TRUNCATED: every class is listed. A class is a FIELD, not a rotation — one square class can hold several angles. `families` counts radius pairs including those no line of the base realises; `edge_capable_families` counts only pairs with ab a square in K, which is necessary for any cross edge to exist.
